scope: Development policy pilots; no multi-layout or hardware performance claim.

uncertainty.method: pointwise percentile bootstrap of the mean
uncertainty.analysis_unit: paired seed; paired differences are formed before resampling

statistics.scope: Detector/sensor Monte Carlo repeats on declared layouts; not independent environment validation unless layout variation is selected. Endpoint averages include incomplete outcomes and are not matched work. Milestones require both trajectories to reach the threshold. Curves use only pairs with observations at that time; no endpoint carry-forward, extrapolation or padded zero dose. The changing paired_n is reported explicitly. CIs are fixed-seed pointwise percentile bootstrap intervals for the mean, not simultaneous bands or mission safety guarantees.
